terms.comment: Greek ἀπόστολος, one sent out. Without a name the Fathers mean Paul (see epistle).

phrases.latin: Duodecim autem Apostolōrum nōmina sunt haec.
phrases.english: These are the names of the twelve apostles.
he picked it up, opened it, and found the apostle Paul
